text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Across PD, HIV and CRC stool, 108 of 145 untied paired experiments had the larger cellulose annotation share in the decreased signature (p = 3.0×10⁻⁹); outside stool most

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: strata have fewer than six untied pairs.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: Paired experiment: one BugSigDB experiment with both an increased and a decreased signature; the share compared is cellulose annotations over all retained non-MediaDive annotations. Ties excluded. Study rows

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: take the sign of each study's mean paired difference. The Fisher tests treat units as independent; a few studies sampled both compartments, and the sites differ in sampling effort (C), so a difference between

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: compartments is not evidence of anatomical specificity. PD, Parkinson's disease; HIV, HIV infection; CRC, colorectal cancer. BugSigDB 2026-04-24_00:41_UTC; human profiles; condition and body site from each
